reviews.review:
[table]
[tr][th]GOAL[/th]
[td]Move the slidable white square block and cover all the empty spaces in each level with a solid rainbow trail, while in later levels, encountering numbered breakable blocks that count down each time they're bumped by the white square, and a pair of teleporters.[/td][/tr]
[tr][th]EXPERIENCE[/th]
[td]Played similar video games on mobile, playing a load of levels from them, only that it lacks numbered breakable blocks and teleporters, that this game stands out from those games.[/td][/tr]
[tr][th]SETUP[/th]
[td]Played it in fullscreen with audio volume default to on, and keeping the white square block movement default to slow speed, until turning on fast speed on level 376. Initially controlled the game with the arrow keyboard keys but than used the mouse cursor to swipe.[/td][/tr]
[tr][th]CONTENT[/th]
[td]500 levels to play through linearly.[/td][/tr]
[tr][th]BOUGHT[/th]
[td]Bought it on 2025 August 30 for 1.52$ when the game launched on 2025 August 26 with a launch discount, which of this review, if not discounted is 2.99$.[/td][/tr]
[tr][th]ENDGAME[/th]
[td]Finishing all 500 levels without using the hint system.[/td][/tr]
[tr][th]PLAYTIME[/th]
[td]157 minutes, or 2.616 hours overall.
[list][*]Level 1-100 - 23.5 minutes.
[*]Level 101-200 - 27.5 minutes.
[*]Level 201-300 - 35.5 minutes.
[*]Level 301-400 - 31 minutes.
[*]Level 401-500 - 39.5 minutes.[/list]Playstyle consists of playing through the game without using hints at all.[/td][/tr]
[/table]

[h3]MY POSITIVES[/h3]
[list]
[*][b][u]There's Steam achievements to earn!;[/u][/b] having video games being more tailored to Steam features increases the likelihood that these aren't stolen games that are reuploaded from nefarious people who want to profit off from unsuspecting users, if this [url=https://www.gamepressure.com/newsroom/steam-is-dealing-with-spam-valves-platform-has-been-flooded-with/zb811a]GamePressure article back in 2025 June[/url] indicates, and having Steam achievements is definitely one indicator. It also feels nice to see a completed game be listed under the 'Perfect Games' list on user accounts, especially on mine.

[*][b][u]There are easier levels consisting of making fun-looking images or shapes;[/u][/b] just really enjoyable seeing the image form by my actions of moving the slidable white square block.[/list]

[h3]MY NEGATIVES[/h3]
[list]
[*][b][u]There's no confirm dialog on using a hint during a level in case of accidental inputs;[/u][/b] imagine if accidentally pressing the 'H' keyboard key, or the hint button with the mouse cursor, that would mean, and it would be worse the further you're in the game, if say you're at level 500, the final level, and accidentally used a hint, that would mean having to replay the entire game again assuming the save file got restarted or deleted.

[*][b][u]The 'Hint' function is more of giving the entire level solution than just giving 1 valid move on what to do next;[/u][/b] I completed the game without using the hint system because of the 'Gold Brain' achievement to get it without using hints at all, so I checked how the hint system works, so I'm a bit baffled this just gives you the entire solution instead of a single move, considering that one of the games by the same developer, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2539560]Fill Multicolor[/url], upon using that game's hint system, it gives the next 5 valid moves. If this is intended behavior, I think it should've been called a 'Level Solution' instead.

[*][b][u]There's no way to rebind or change keyboard key controls[/u][/b]; I instinctively keep having my hand on the WASD keyboard keys to control the white square for movement because I've been playing games lately that use the WASD keyboard keys, but the only keyboard keys for movements are the arrow keys, and I instead reverted back to just swiping the movements with the mouse cursor.

[*][b][u]Game lacks the reset progress function;[/u][/b] alternatively, I could try finding where the save file is and delete it, but I'm having a bit of a hard time doing so. This would be helpful for people who want to speedrun the game, have someone else play the game, or to try and get the 'Gold Brain' Steam achievement. Related note, I tried to also reset progress on Fill Multicolor, one of their other games they made, because the game has added new achievements since finishing the game that I can't earn anymore unless I reset progress.

[*][b][u]There are no more levels beyond level 500[/u][/b]; this is not from the game itself necessarily, but the Steam game page, which currently says, "offers over 500 hand-crafted levels" at one paragraph, but one of the bulletpoints says it's "500 hand-crafted puzzles". If without YouTube videos or external sources, the only way to find out is having to buy the game, which I feel you should not confuse or deceive people wanting to buy your game. It would be a different story if there were more levels added, which I'm not really expecting since it's up to the dev, but it would definitely be nice.

[*][b][u]Exiting the game is only possible with the 'Esc' keyboard key;[/u][/b] there's no way to exit the game with entirely the computer mouse.

[*][b][u]Audio volume controls on sound effects and music is only on or off, with no way to fine-tune it;[/u][/b] I couldn't play the game while I was in a voice call with people, and I wanted to hear the game, but not turn off the audio entirely. I had to play the game eventually when I'm by my own.

[*][b][u]The game's additional obstacles being the numbered breakable blocks and teleporters feel like they aren't used to the fullest extent, making the game feel it ended too early pacing-wise;[/u][/b] usually, I'm content with what I'm given when playing these kinds of games, because for most of these types of games, if lacking a level editor, they would've exhausted whatever possibility the amount and types of puzzles can be made before it feels like too much repetition. Again, it doesn't have to be entirely new obstacles to be made for this game that is the solution of this kind of sentiment I have with the game, even though that would be pretty nice to see, I just felt that as I'm reaching towards the end, I was thinking of encountering having numbered breakable blocks go up to 3 or maybe 4, or a second pair of teleporters, maybe multiple but distinctively different not only color but shape, as that would've go really wild with it with a mix of fun and difficult levels.[/list]
Swipepi is a pretty nice game to play through, especially as a nice breather from the more involved video games for the past couple of days that require stronger attention and focus. Admittedly, it was bit on the easier side compared to similar games I played, as the only levels I truly had trouble were level 236, level 343, and level 446, which took longer than usual to solve without hints, so I was able to go through the game faster than I expected. The one thing specific to this game I have a slight issue being the game's obstacles aren't maximized of their potential enough with wanting to encounter numbered breakable blocks going up to 3 or 4, and multiple teleporters.

Notably, some of the issues with Swipepi seem might also apply with most of their other games they've released on Steam, such as a lack of exit button on the main menu with the mouse cursor (which Fill Multicolor has but not their other games as far as I know), a variable volume slider, lacking the ability of resetting progress, and being able to rebind keyboard keys if applicable. AleC Games, I thank you for bothering to update yours games on Steam, you did address some of the issues, one of which all of your games currently have Steam achievements. The reason I pointed these issues out is I like for your games to succeed and help make more of these types of games released on Steam instead of them having them kept on mobile devices.
